12. API tests with Postman
API tests send requests and assert status, headers, response shape and business behavior.
Postman එJකන් request යවලා status code, response body සහ headers පරීක්ෂා කරනවා.
GET /products should return a JSON array with HTTP 200.

Request: GET · /products API Response: 200 + JSON Assertions · Read the diagram: Request: GET /products → API → Response: 200 + JSON → Assertions. · Postman එJකන් request යවලා status code, response body සහ headers පරීක්ෂා කරනවා.
Expected result: Both tests pass when the endpoint responds 200 with an array.

Q: What should an API test assert?
A: Status, schema, meaningful data, errors and side effects where appropriate.
